en: Put cheap/high-tier fodder in front of Aegir carries: they steal base ATK and block, gain layers, and (5) revive. Tier-6 fodder gives +6 layers per battle.
5000 physical HP loss ignores DEF and shields

[Siracusa] Operators gain increased <@ba.vup>ASPD</> for a duration after deployment<@autochess.gray>(affected by Stacks)</>
<<@autochess.dgreen>6</> different [Siracusa] Operators on field> [Siracusa] Operators enter Camouflage for the same duration after deployment; while in Camouflage and within <@ba.vup>10</> seconds after leaving it, [Siracusa] Operators' attacks have a <@ba.vup>3%</> chance to deal True damage<@autochess.gray>(affected by Stacks)</> and inflict <@ba.vup>Fear</> for 3 seconds

[Siracusa] Operators ASPD <@ba.vup>+{0:0}</> for <@ba.vup>{1:0}</> seconds after deployment<@ba.acrem>(affected by Stacks)</>
<<@ba.vup>6</> different [Siracusa] Operators on field> [Siracusa] Operators also enter Camouflage for the same duration after deployment; while in Camouflage and within 10 seconds after leaving it, their attacks have a 3% chance to deal <@ba.vup>{2:0}</><@ba.acrem>(affected by Stacks)</> True damage and inflict <@ba.vup>Fear</> on the target for 3 seconds
After every deployment (incl. redeploy) a Siracusa member gains ASPD +(25 + 0.8*L) for (32 + 0.4*L) s.

After deployment also Camouflage (camouflage) for the same duration. While camouflaged and for 10 s after it ends, each normal damage instance it deals may add (5000 + 50*L) true damage (source = the operator) and Fear (fear) 3 s. Nominal 3% chance, implemented as pseudo-random: all Siracusa members share one counter; attempt n since last proc succeeds with p = 0.00139*n (guaranteed at n = 720); counter resets on proc.

Shop refresh-driven: Lappland first manual refresh each round +4 (works from bench); Angelina at Rest Phase end +4 per refresh this round (<=12/round); Aroma +2 Siracusa/Arcane per refresh (<=6); Vigil first 3 kills +2 Siracusa +1 Marvel; Lappland the Decadenza each kill +2 (elite: every Siracusa gets this, <=100/battle); Rendong on gain +6 own bonds (x2/x3 with Investor); Improv "Texas's Oath" +10. Strategy Javi: every 6 manual refreshes get a free Siracusa (<=2/round).
Refresh a lot in prep (free refresh sources: Provence, Texas, Texas the Omertosa, Shamare) to feed Lappland/Angelina; pair with Investor for Rendong.
Camouflage = standard AK camouflage (not targeted by ranged enemies unless blocking)

Each time an Operator is deployed, [Kazimierz] Operators gain ATK <@ba.vup>+20%</> until battle end<@autochess.gray>(cap affected by Stacks)</>
<<@autochess.dgreen>6</> different [Kazimierz] Operators on field> While blocking enemies, [Kazimierz] Operators deal True damage equal to <@ba.vup>120%</> ATK to nearby enemies every <@ba.vup>2</> seconds and Stun them for <@ba.vup>0.1</> seconds; while not blocking, attacks deal additional True damage equal to <@ba.vup>30%</> ATK

Each time an Operator is deployed, [Kazimierz] Operators gain ATK +20% (max <@ba.vup>+{0:0%}</>)<@ba.acrem>(affected by Stacks)</>
<<@ba.vup>6</> different [Kazimierz] Operators on field> While blocking enemies, [Kazimierz] Operators deal True damage equal to <@ba.vup>120%</> ATK to nearby enemies every 2 seconds and Stun them for <@ba.vup>0.1</> seconds; while not blocking, attacks deal additional True damage equal to <@ba.vup>30%</> ATK
Every time any friendly operator is deployed (incl. redeploys) each Kazimierz member gains ATK +20% until battle end, capped at +(50 + 1*L)%.

Deploy-driven in battle: Gravel on deploy +1; Blemishine on deploy +4 own active bonds (<=12/battle); Fartooth grants the right-most operator in its row "on deploy +4 Kazimierz/Precision (<=24/battle)"; Degenbrecher on deploy +8 (<=24); On gain: Wild Mane +2, Ashlock +3 to highest-layer bond; Improv "Mlynar's Oath" +12. Strategy Mlynar: +1 gold next round per Kazimierz bought (<=3).
Maximise deploy events: low redeploy time (Aid -30%, Knight's Code), operators that die/retreat and come back (Gravel + Resilient). Bahamut: do not light Durable (damage sharing keeps Gravel alive).
